exposure: Preeclampsia and eclampsia superimposed on preexisting HTN
outcome: Preeclampsia and eclampsia superimposed on preexisting HTN
cohort: 9,096,788 deliveries, including 86,615 pregnant women with Diabetes Mellitus (DM) and 1,233 with diabetic retinopathy
finding: Diabetic retinopathy in women with DM increased the risk of pregnancy-induced hypertension, preeclampsia, premature delivery, cesarean section, transfusion, and hysterectomy, but not fetal complications.
mod_finding: Diabetic retinopathy in women with DM increased the risk of cesarean section and decreased the likelihood of spontaneous vaginal delivery
